caption: Highest-severity category per eligible variant–RCV–inheritance unit; denominator 179,613. T0 is no derived disagreement, not necessarily identical source labels. P/LP = pathogenic/likely pathogenic; U = uncertain significance; B/LB = benign/likely benign.
interpretation: Public-record disagreement, not a new clinical classification

caption: Each point is a gene with at least 30 eligible single-gene variants and complete reference-stratum coverage. Expected counts use leave-one-gene-out backgrounds stratified by organization count, variant type, expert involvement and evaluation age, with prespecified pooling. Dashed line: observed equals expected. Descriptive screen; no significance or clinical-risk claim.
interpretation: Public-record disagreement, not a new clinical classification

caption: Empirical distributions of the oldest and newest nonmissing relevant evaluation dates per eligible unit. These are evaluation ages, not durations of conflict. Units with missing dates are retained in the study and their counts are reported separately; curves omit missing values.
interpretation: Public-record disagreement, not a new clinical classification

caption: T1/T2 units divided by all eligible units in each official RCV review-status category; numerators and denominators are shown. Bars are 95% percentile intervals from 2,000 resamples clustered by VariationID, with seed 20260926; they account for repeated units within the same variant. Finite-record counts are exact; uncertainty is model-based. Review-status association is not causal.
interpretation: Public-record disagreement, not a new clinical classification

caption: Entities are ranked by disputed fractional participation. A variant is divided across its genes or disputed condition sets; each disputed unit is divided across qualifying organizations. Domains use different units and ascertainment, so curves are descriptive and do not establish responsibility for disagreement.
interpretation: Public-record disagreement, not a new clinical classification

caption: Fifteen complete condition sets with the most eligible variants, selected by denominator rather than conflict count. interpretation: Public-record disagreement, not a new clinical classification

caption: Mutually exclusive first-applicable assertion dispositions, before organization deduplication and the requirement for at least two qualifying organizations per unit.
